## Review Area

- [ ] Sidecar auth / localhost exposure
- [ ] Relationship-scope isolation
- [ ] Raw-data immutability
- [ ] Deletion / audit logging
- [ ] Consent / data category policy
- [ ] Source path privacy
- [ ] LLM / voice safety

## Concern

Describe the concern without exposing private data or exploit details.

## Evidence

Link code, docs, tests, or checklist entries.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Regression test added or updated
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior changes
- [ ] Security checklist status updated
